    Platform tokens

    Parsed live from generated/platform-default.css. Click any token to copy its var(). Dark values are authored, not inverted.

    Logo set v2

    Light files go on light surfaces, dark files on dark. Clear space is 25% of mark height. Minimum height: wordmark 24 px, mark 16 px. Gold is a logo colour only (2.7:1 on white), never UI text. These are raster files (about 1200 px wide); large print needs a redrawn SVG.

    Repo layout & setup

    Everything lives in one workspace package, packages/design-system. Click a path to see what it is and whether you edit it by hand.

    Select a file

    Click anything in the tree.

    Wire it into apps/web

    1
    Unzip at the repo root and install
    unzip edumyles-design-system-package.zip
npm install   # or pnpm install
    2
    Add the workspace dependency in apps/web/package.json
    "@edumyles/design-system": "*"
    3
    Import tokens and map them to Tailwind v4 in app/globals.css
    @import "tailwindcss";
@import "@edumyles/design-system/css";
@theme inline {
  --color-background: var(--background);   --color-foreground: var(--foreground);
  --color-primary: var(--primary);         --color-primary-foreground: var(--primary-foreground);
  --color-muted: var(--muted);             --color-muted-foreground: var(--muted-foreground);
  --color-border: var(--border);           --color-ring: var(--ring);
  --radius-lg: var(--radius);
}
    4
    Inject the tenant theme before first paint (app/layout.tsx): resolve tenant in middleware, render <style id="tenant-theme"> in the head, set data-tenant and data-theme on <html>. Fall back to the platform theme if compile fails.
    5
    Copy logos and favicon
    npm run sync:assets -w @edumyles/design-system -- ../../apps/web/public/brand

    Day-to-day commands

    npm run test -w @edumyles/design-systemRun the 6 compiler tests
    npm run build:themes -w @edumyles/design-systemRecompile every example theme into generated/
    npm run verify -w @edumyles/design-systemTests + regenerate + fail if generated/ changed (use in CI)
